title: μ_R = Θ·Hⁿ when the density exists everywhere
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity representation of S in ℝ^P (R : IMRep univ n with R.Represents S). Let Θ : ℝ^P → ℝ satisfy HasMassDensity S x Θ(x) for every x ∈ ℝ^P. Then R.measure = θ·H^n⌞M is equal to H^n.withDensity(x ↦ ofReal Θ(x)), where H^n = μHE[n]; equivalently μ_R(A) = ∫⁻_A ofReal Θ dH^n for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Θ : Euclid P → ℝ), R.Represents S → (∀ x : Euclid P, HasMassDensity S x (Θ x)) → R.measure = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (Θ x))
